summary: An announcement of the next Network Working Group meeting, hosted by MIT's Project MAC in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It was planned in three phases, starting with a workshop for system programmers, so most people would only attend one or two parts. Its dates were later changed. It was replaced by RFC 212.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 207 announces a Network Working Group meeting planned at MIT's Project MAC. The event has a hands-on workshop, smaller topic workshops, and a plenary session.

subtitle: An August 1971 announcement outlines a three-phase NWG meeting at MIT.

tldr.problem: The Network Working Group needed to coordinate its technical work and plan a meeting where network participants could share results.
tldr.mechanism: RFC 207 announces three phases at MIT's Project MAC: a systems programmers workshop, topic-focused workshops, and an open plenary session.
tldr.outcome: The announcement gives the proposed schedule and registration details. RFC 207 was later obsoleted by RFC 212.

today: RFC 207 is historic and was obsoleted by RFC 212. It is a meeting announcement, not a protocol specification.

sections.title: A Three-Phase Meeting
sections.content: The announcement describes a Network Working Group meeting hosted by MIT's Project MAC in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It was scheduled to begin at noon on September 26 and was tentatively scheduled to adjourn on September 30. The notice says participants would likely attend only one or two phases.
sections.plainLanguage: The meeting was planned for September 26 to September 30, 1971. It had three phases so participants could attend the parts relevant to their work.

sections.title: Workshops and Plenary
sections.content: The first phase was a systems programmers workshop on September 26 and 27, where programmers would demonstrate their hosts over the network and discuss implementation. The second phase on September 28 and 29 consisted of small workshops on network-use topics. The third phase was an open plenary on September 30 to present workshop reports and other activities.
sections.plainLanguage: Programmers first planned demonstrations, then smaller groups discussed topics, and finally participants could hear the reports at a plenary session.

sections.title: Registration and Planning Details
sections.content: The announcement asks attendees to register with Anne Speare at Project MAC and gives contacts for workshop applications. It says more information about workshop scope, chairs, and schedules would be announced on August 16. The Network Steering Committee members are listed at the end of the notice.
sections.plainLanguage: Attendees were asked to register and contact the organizers about workshop participation. Further workshop details were to follow.
